criterion.question: Did the agent correctly and completely resolve the customer's request while following the retail agent policy (authenticate first, confirm before database changes, no invented information, only permitted actions)?
criterion.notes: Adapted from tau-bench retail historical trajectories (gpt-4o). humanLabel is the environment reward from a database-state and output check, not a human label. reviewerDisagreement is a PROXY: true when the same task passed in some of its 4 trials and failed in others. Comparison sample: seed 107 sample of one trajectory per task, 109 of the 109 tasks (of 115) that have a trajectory up to 24,000 characters, from tau-bench 59a200c. The label is the environment reward, not a human label.
